title: feat(runtime): PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id edits a package's manifest dependencies
body:
Fixes #24670
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changed

`PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id` now accepts the manifest's `dependencies` row beside `name`, `description` and `version`, flat or under the `manifest` wrapper.

- **The door** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, the `PATCH /packages/:id` arm only). The row is judged by `ManifestSchema.shape.dependencies` from `@objectstack/spec`, the row `POST /packages` parses at create. Nothing is restated. A malformed row is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the envelope the create door answers for the same row, before the protocol or the registry is reached. So nothing is written, including a valid key sent beside it. The "nothing to update" 400 now names `dependencies` among the accepted keys.
- **The registry** (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `SchemaRegistry.updatePackageManifest` only). It copies `dependencies` when present. The row replaces the stored one whole, never a deep merge, and the registry keeps its own copy. An entry the row leaves out is removed, and `{}` clears the declaration. Replacing the object, rather than editing it in place, also keeps the protocol's shallow pre-patch snapshot able to put the prior row back when the durable write fails.
- **The protocol** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `updatePackage` only). The `patch` type gains `dependencies`. Persistence needed no change: `updatePackage` already re-persists the whole merged manifest through `persistPackageManifest`.

The objectui half (Studio's edit dialog sends only the three keys) is not in this PR. Triage `6279169921` routes it to objectui once this door accepts the row.

## Mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **The widened registry merge carries `dependencies` into `sys_packages`.** Holds on both branches. On the protocol branch, pin (a) reads the `sys_packages` row through the real `PackageServicePlugin` and re-reads it after a restart. On the in-memory fallback, the door test reads the registry and `GET /packages/:id`.
2. **The closure reader reads `manifest.dependencies` live.** Holds. The one runtime reader is `resolveWritePackageScope` (`protocol.ts`). It walks `registry.getPackage(id).manifest.dependencies` on every write and caches nothing. `git grep` found no other runtime reader of `manifest.dependencies` in `metadata-protocol`, `objectql`, `runtime`, `services/*` or `lint`. Pin (d) shows the next save sees the edit with nothing retired.
3. **A malformed row takes the create door's envelope.** Holds. `POST /packages` with `dependencies: { "com.acme.core": 1 }` answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`. The PATCH answers the same `status` and `code`, and a parity test pins this.
4. **The new key follows the arm's flat or wrapped reading.** Holds. Both forms are pinned, and the refusal locates the key as `dependencies.KEY` or `manifest.dependencies.KEY`, following the form the caller wrote.

## Removing a dependency: readings for the seat

The PATCH applies the row as given, and no in-use check was built. Measured over the integration harness below, which runs the real `ObjectQL`, `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3), `PackageServicePlugin`, protocol on the default authoring channel and `HttpDispatcher`. Package P declares D. A list view stored in P binds to D's object. Then `PATCH /packages/P` sends `{ "dependencies": {} }`, which answers `200`, and the steps below were measured with a one-off probe that is not committed:

| step | answer |
|:--|:--|
| read, `protocol.getMetaItem` | resolves; `_diagnostics: { valid: true }` |
| read, `GET /meta/view/NAME` (dispatcher) | `200`, no `_diagnostics` on the item |
| registry after removal | still serves the view |
| re-save of the unchanged body, `protocol.saveMetaItem` | `422 INVALID_METADATA`, rule `list-view-object-outside-closure`; the stored row is unchanged |
| re-save, `PUT /meta/view/NAME?package=P` (dispatcher) | `422 INVALID_METADATA`, rule `list-view-object-outside-closure` |
| re-hydrate in process, `loadMetaFromDb()` | `{ loaded: 2, errors: 0, invalid: 0, storeUnavailable: false }`; the view stays registered |
| restart (same database), package row | `dependencies: {}` served |
| restart, `loadMetaFromDb()` | `{ loaded: 2, errors: 0, invalid: 0, storeUnavailable: false }`; the view is registered |
| restart, read `GET /meta/view/NAME` | `200` |
| restart, re-save | `422 INVALID_METADATA`, `list-view-object-outside-closure` |

So an item stored before the removal keeps loading and serving, and neither the boot count nor the read badge flags it. Its next save is refused with the closure verdict, which names the remedy (declare the dependency again).

## Tests

All runs are on head `0fcd8e42c` unless noted. `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` resolve to `dist/` in the runtime suites, so both were rebuilt before every reading.

- **Red before the fix** (commit `7a83ce21f`, pre-fix build): 13 of 16 runtime cases and both registry cases failed. The `(d)` refusal step already passed (`422 INVALID_METADATA`, `list-view-object-outside-closure`) and the case failed at the PATCH: `400 "Body { name?, description?, version? } — nothing to update"`. A valid `name` sent beside a malformed row answered `200` and was written.
- **New pins, green:**
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-patch-dependencies.test.ts`: real `HttpDispatcher` over a real `SchemaRegistry`. Covers the row persisted flat and wrapped, whole-row replace, four malformed rows refused with nothing written, refusal before the protocol is called, parity with `POST /packages`, and (c) the three existing keys as before.
  - `packages/runtime/src/package-dependencies-patch.integration.test.ts`: (a) persisted, served, stored in `sys_packages` and served after a restart; (b) malformed refused with neither store moving, and a `sys_packages`-refused edit (a trigger) answers `500` with the prior row back in the registry, `GET` and the store; (d) the remedy end to end.
  - `packages/objectql/src/registry.test.ts`: two `[#24670]` cases.
  - Result: `Tests 17 passed (17)` and `Tests 103 passed (103)`.
- **Package suites:**
  - `@objectstack/objectql` (`--project local`): `Test Files 448 passed (448)`, `Tests 8449 passed (8449)`.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: `Test Files 249 passed | 3 skipped (252)`, `Tests 20781 passed | 19 skipped (20800)`.
  - `@objectstack/runtime` (`--project local`): `Test Files 427 passed (427)`, `Tests 6695 passed | 19 skipped (6714)`.
  - Each `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter` on the three packages exits 0, including each package's `check:test-typecheck`.
- **Ablation** (commit `c88492672`). Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the line `if (patch.dependencies !== undefined) manifest.dependencies = { ...patch.dependencies };` was deleted: anchor 1 to 0, blob `0d0948aec118` to `d2dd6f3e9d62`.
  - `objectql` was rebuilt, and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/objectql "manifest.dependencies = {" --absent` found the marker absent from all 14 built files. Before the mutation it was present in 4 (`core.js`, `core.mjs`, `index.js`, `index.mjs`).
  - Red under the ablation: (a), (d), the rollback case, the three fallback-persistence cases and both registry cases. The door's refusal cases stayed green, as expected: they do not reach the registry.
  - Restore: blob back to `0d0948aec118`, `git diff HEAD` empty. After a rebuild, the preflight found the marker in 4 files, the tree was clean, and the 17 + 2 cases were green.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `0fcd8e42c` derived 72 commands. `--ran` reconciliation: 72 accounted, 71 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET. It reads the whole workspace's `dist/`, and only this card's closure was built. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` and `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` refused on the shallow clone. After deepening (`git fetch --shallow-since=2026-07-14`), both exit 0.
- The roster families whose roster is in a touched directory (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:route-ledger-census`) exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) exits 0 at `0fcd8e42c`.

## Export measurement (sets the bumps)

The `dist` `.d.ts` was compared before and after.

- **`@objectstack/objectql`:** `index.d.ts` and `core.d.ts` are identical, apart from the chunk hash. One signature changed: `SchemaRegistry.updatePackageManifest`'s `patch` gains `dependencies?: Record(string, string)`.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`:** one signature changed: `updatePackage`'s `request.patch` gains the same optional key.

No export was added, removed or renamed. Both are accept-set widenings, so the changeset takes `minor` on all three packages (runtime, objectql, metadata-protocol).

## Acceptance notes

- **The spec contract still declares three keys.** `EngineSchemaRegistryView.updatePackageManifest` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/objectql-engine.ts:131`) types the patch as `name`, `description` and `version`. The door's in-memory fallback calls the registry through that contract type, and it compiles because the patch is a declared variable, not a fresh literal. `packages/spec` is held off in this dispatch. Carrier: the `domain:spec` seat.
- **The ADR-0070 read-only gate is on `main` (#24705, PR #24719 → `9b2953d62`) and runs before this PR's body read.** So a package the deployment ships answers `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` for a `dependencies` edit too, with nothing written. #24719's pins cover a `{ dependencies: {} }` body on all four read-only kinds, on both limbs, and stay green on this branch after it merged `main` (merge `7a8557cff`). _(This note replaces the round-1 note that said the arm asked no read-only question. Edited by the `domain:cli` seat 2 after the merge.)_
- **`updatePackage` is typed `any` in this file.** `PackagesDomainProtocol.updatePackage` is still `(request: any)`, in the "undeclared request shapes" group of `packages.ts`. Typing it from the producer's own signature, as `revertStoredPackage` is, would make a key this door sends that the producer does not declare a compile error. Carrier: none.
